This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing. I did not commit a revision or submit a solve job.

The case needs two `ReverseOsmosis0D` units, RO1 and RO2, each a membrane model. They must apply water and salt permeabilities (A, B), a fixed concentration polarization modulus, a pressure drop and a membrane area. They must also split the feed into a permeate and a retentate. `list_models` shows no unit that does this. The available units are adiabatic mixers, feed sources, product sinks, stream splitters, TP and PH flashes, heaters and heat exchangers, a liquid pump, a valve, a component separator, and conversion, kinetic and surrogate reactors.

None of these can stand in for the RO units. The splitter and component separator use fixed split fractions, so they have no membrane flux or rejection equations. The rest of the case does have counterparts: `syn001.feed_source`, `syn001.liquid_pump` and `syn001.product_sink`. I did not use a substitute for the missing unit, because that would change what the case simulates.

`list_models` also doesn't expose property packages or component lists, so I couldn't check whether an NaCl–water package like `NaCl_prop_pack` exists. The RO units are the only gap I can confirm.
